summary: Keeps the immutable OSS host chart version and appVersion synchronized with every managed OSS release so chart publication cannot fail after container promotion.
userImpact: Release operators receive a signed host chart whose default application version matches the corresponding published OSS containers.
EnterpriseGlue 0.19.2 fixes forward from the 0.19.1 host-chart publication failure without changing application behavior.

instructions: Use the host chart published with the matching OSS release and keep backend and frontend images pinned to the digests recorded by that release.

notes: This packaging correction does not change database schemas, migrations, or rollback windows.

security: Release preparation derives the next chart patch from the previous immutable release tag and binds appVersion to the managed OSS release version.
The protected workflow continues to require exact source tags, signatures, reproducible archives, immutable OCI subjects, smoke tests, and vulnerability gates.
documentation: The versioned release notes identify the corrected host-chart publication and the exact compatible OSS application release.
knownLimitations: The v0.19.1 application containers are valid, signed, scanned, and smoke-tested, but its host-chart workflow did not publish a matching chart; v0.19.2 is the deployable fix-forward release unit.
rollback: Roll back to a previously published chart together with its matching immutable backend and frontend image digests; do not combine a chart with a different application release unless explicitly qualified.
validation: Reproduce the v0.19.1 protected host-chart failure caused by appVersion 0.19.0 not matching release v0.19.1.
Run release-note and chart-version synchronization unit tests, host-chart validation, release-policy contracts, and the release-candidate readiness lane.
Publish the fix-forward patch through the protected hotfix workflow and verify the signed OCI chart receipt against the exact release commit.
